ModuleTitle.helper: Used to sync with the system's module title. This does not display to site visitors. It makes it useful to restore and share content, if/when needed.
ModuleTitle.placeholder: Try entering anything that's somewhat unique

ModuleAnchor.helper: Optional. Used to create a page anchor, such as local-business-spotlight. Use letters, numbers, and hyphens only.

SectionTitle.helper: Optional. Main heading shown above the spotlight.

SectionDescription.helper: Optional. Short supporting text shown under the section title. Formatted text and links are allowed and will render in the view.

SpotlightTitle.helper: Required. The headline for the featured business. Formatted text and links are allowed and will render in the view.

SpotlightDescription.helper: Required. One short paragraph describing the featured business and why visitors should learn more. Formatted text and links are allowed and will render in the view.
SpotlightDescription.placeholder: Write a warm, helpful paragraph that introduces the business, mentions what they do, and explains why they are valuable to the local community.

SpotlightImage.helper: Required. Use a high-quality image for the featured business. Recommended minimum size: 1800px wide by 1200px high.

SpotlightImageAltText.helper: Optional, but strongly recommended. Describe the image clearly for accessibility and SEO.
SpotlightImageAltText.placeholder: Two team members smile inside a local business showroom.

MemberLandingPage.helper: Required. Select or enter the featured member's landing page. Local and external web addresses are both allowed.

CTAURL.helper: Optional. Select or enter the secondary button web addresses. For example, this could link to the membership page.

CTAText.helper: Optional. Text for the secondary button button. This only displays when button web addresses is also filled in. Formatted text and links are allowed and will render in the view.
